Election Commission's Appointment Process Under Scrutiny

The appointment process for the Election Commission of India, specifically the role of the Cabinet Secretary as a gatekeeper and controller, has become a subject of discussion. The Election Commission, which evolved from a single Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) to a three-member body, is central to this discourse.
